title: Map2World: Segment Map Conditioned Text to 3D World Generation
summary: A framework for generating large-scale, continuous 3D environments from top-down segment maps and text prompts. It employs a multi-diffusion strategy to coordinate overlapping 3D windows, ensuring seamless transitions and scale consistency across expansive worlds.
research_notes: Jointly developed by Seoul National University and Microsoft Research Asia; source code is currently listed as coming soon.

evolution.summary: Map2World builds upon the TRELLIS asset generator, evolving from object-level synthesis to city-scale world generation with support for arbitrary segment maps and high-resolution detail enhancement.
